name: Graceful Toss (Ex)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Finesse training class feature

Benefit(s): Whenever a rogue with this talent makes a ranged attack with a thrown weapon that she has also selected with finesse training, she adds her Dexterity modifier instead of her Strength modifier to the damage roll. If any effect would prevent the rogue from adding her Strength modifier to the damage roll, she does not add her Dexterity modifier.
